description: Exploración espacial en el sector Salud ,Medicina .
summary:
Objective: To design a robotic system for astronauts (a rover that plants vegetable seeds—crops that benefit the astronauts' health—and monitors each astronaut's vital signs).
Specific Objectives: To design a robotic system—constructed from recycled materials—capable of monitoring astronauts' vital signs (both autonomously and manually) and accompanying them during spacewalks.HypothesisAn effective design for a robotic system for astronauts.
details: •Problem FormulationAstronauts are exposed daily to conditions different from those on Earth. How can robotic technology be effectively integrated to assist astronauts—specifically for monitoring their vital signs?Demonstrating the functionality of the robot that monitors vital signs, and the development of a rover.
